I am the oldest of the four sisters.|Tera|BotW}} * [[Great Fairy Kaysa]] {{Small|(second-eldest sister)}}{{Cite|My older sister Kaysa is at a stable near the Gerudo region to the south.|Great Fairy Mija|TotK}} * [[Great Fairy Cotera]] {{Small|(youngest sister)}}{{Cite|My younger sister Cotera is at a stable near {{Color TotK|Red|Dueling Peaks}} in Necluda southeast of here.|Great Fairy Mija|TotK}} }} |voiceactor= Jenn Wong {{Small|(English)}}{{Cite Web|quote= This world is part of my childhood and I’m so thrilled to play The Great Fairy Mija.|author= Jenn Wong|published= November 20, 2020|retrieved= December 15, 2020|url= https://www.instagram.com/p/CH1gjoljPVB/|title= |site= Instagram|type= }} |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Great Fairy Mija||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|TotK}}{{Cite|Great Fairy Mija|Game Screen|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Mija||BotW, AoC}},{{Exp Game|BotW, AoC}}{{Cite|Mija|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color AoC|Red|Mija}}|Game Screen|AoC}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Mija is a [[Great Fairy]] who resides in her [[Mija's Great Fairy Fountain|Great Fairy Fountain]] in the [[Akkala]] [[Region]]. Like the other Great Fairies, Mija will upgrade [[Link]]'s [[Armor]] in exchange for [[Material]]s.{{Cite|Thanks to you, I've been returned to my former glory. And as they say—one good turn deserves another. I can help you, boy. Allow me to {{Color BotW|Red|enhance}} your {{Color BotW|Red|clothing}}. It's the least I can do, but I will need the necessary {{Color BotW|Red|materials}}...|Mija|BotW}} When Link comes across Mija's Great Fairy Fountain, it will be closed. If Link approaches the Fountain, he will hear the voice of Mija asking him to listen to her story.{{Cite|{{Small|Boy...}} Sweet boy... Please... Listen to my story...|Mija|BotW}} Should Link agree, Mija introduces herself, explaining that her Fountain was once a spring. However, when travelers stopped offering [[Rupee]]s to her, she lost her power.{{Cite|But as time passed, fewer and fewer travelers arrived to offer me rupees. As a result, my power has abandoned me.|Mija|BotW}} To restore her power, Mija requires Rupees.{{Cite|I'm nearly powerless now, so I beg your help. I need rupees to become whole again.|Mija|BotW}} Depending on how many out Great Fairies Link has made offerings to, Mija will ask for either 100 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|100 rupees}}...|Mija|BotW}} 500 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|500 rupees}}...|Mija|BotW}} 1,000 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|1,000 rupees}}...|Mija|BotW}} or 10,000 Rupees.{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|10,000 rupees}}...|Mija|BotW}} Mija promises to help Link once he makes an offering to her.{{Cite|Once my power has been restored, I can help you do great things, boy.|Mija|BotW}} Mija's hand will then emerge from her closed Fountain, and she requests that Link hand over his Rupees.{{Cite|Now... If you have rupees, hand them over to me. Quickly!|Mija|BotW}} If Link refuses, Mija will be disappointed.{{Cite|[I'll keep my rupees.] That is truly tragic...|Mija|BotW}} If Link agrees to give her Rupees, Mija will snatch them from Link and thank him.{{Cite|[Here you go.] Thank you. You are too kind.|Mija|BotW}} Mija then proclaims that her power is overflowing, and her Great Fairy Fountain will bloom.{{Cite|Aah... The power... {{Big|It's overflowing!!!}}|Mija|BotW}} With her power restored, Mija will emerge from the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] of her Great Fairy Fountain.{{Cite|{{Big|Ah-HAAAAAAAAAAA!!!}}|Mija|BotW}} She is surprised by Link's appearance, having expected him to be bigger than he is.{{Cite|Mmmmmm. So you're the one who released me. I was expecting someone...bigger, I guess... But a slim little lad like you will do just fine. Yes.|Mija|BotW}} Since Link helped restore her power, Mija decides to offer him a reward.{{Cite|Thanks to you, my power has been returned to me. And I think you'll agree—a good deed deserves a good reward.|Mija|BotW}} She informs Link that she is capable of enhancing his Armor if he provides the correct Materials. The degree to which Mija can enhance Armor depends on how many Great Fairies have had their power restored.{{Cite|With the power available to me... I should be able to enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a little bit}}.|Mija|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a fair amount}}.|Mija|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can {{Color BotW|Red|greatly}} enhance your clothing.|Mija|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|to the max}}!|Mija|BotW}} If Link agrees to enhance his Armor, Mija will ask him to choose a piece to enhance.{{Cite|[Enhance away!] Then please choose some clothes for me.|Mija|BotW}} Once Link makes a selection, Mija will ask him to wait for a moment.{{Cite|One moment...|Mija|BotW}} To enhance the Armor, she will either blow a kiss, kiss Link, hug him, or drag him into her Great Fairy Fountain. Following this, she will occasionally explain [[Set Bonus]]es to Link.{{Cite|There we go. Oh, while you're here... Some sets, if you enhance all parts of them twice, can give you a nice extra set bonus when you wear them. This isn't true of everything I can enhance, sadly...|Mija|BotW}} She then asks Link if he has other pieces of Armor he would like to enhance.{{Cite|Any other clothing items you want me to work on?|Mija|BotW}} Should Link run out of Materials or reach the limits of Mija's power, she will invite him to come back once he has rectified this.{{Cite|Hrm... I wanted to enhance other pieces of clothing, but that does not seem possible. If you get clothes and materials or if you restore my sisters' powers, then I believe I can help you. See you later.|Mija|BotW}} If Link approaches Mija without the supplies to enhance his Armor, she will notice.{{Cite|...However, you are lacking any clothing that I can enhance.|Mija|BotW}} However, she will allow Link to view his Armor enhancements to see what Materials he needs.{{Cite|Here, let's take a look. Maybe I can see what's stopping me from helping.|Mija|BotW}} If not all of the Great Fairy Fountains have been opened, Mija notices when Link ends their conversation that her not all of her sisters' powers have been restored.{{Cite|Hm... It seems like a few of my sisters haven't yet recovered their power. Once they have their power back, I can make your clothes even stronger. See you later.|Mija|BotW}} She tells him that if they all regain their powers, they will be able to enhance his clothing more than she can currently. Following these encounters, Mija will instead invite Link to return when he has more pieces of Armor he wants to upgrade.{{Cite|Hrm... So long for now, I suppose? Once you have some clothing you want to upgrade, come back anytime. See you later.|Mija|BotW}} When Link finishes enhancing his Armor, Mija will dive back into her Great Fairy Fountain.{{Cite|So long!|Mija|BotW}}{{Cite|Good-bye!|Mija|BotW}}{{Cite|And gone!|Mija|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TotK |type= Characters |category= |needs= * Detailed information on the character's role in the story, including what quests they are involved in * Detailed information on where the character lives and travels to, including at what times they can be found in those locations }} {{Quests|width= 42.3rem| {{TotK Quest |name= Serenade to Mija |type= Side Adventure |giver= [[Mastro]] |location= [[Snowfield Stable]] }} }} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Great Fairies Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Mija with her sisters File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 3.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 4.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Great Fairies Portrait Icon 5.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Great Fairies' portrait File:AoC Mija Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mija's portrait File:AoC Mija Portrait Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mija's portrait File:AoC Mija Portrait Icon 3.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mija's portrait File:AoC Mija Portrait Icon 4.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mija's portrait File:AoC Mija Portrait Icon 5.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mija's portrait ==See Also== {{See Also| * Great Fairy * Great Fairy Cotera * Great Fairy Kaysa * Great Fairy Tera * Mija's Great Fairy Fountain }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fairies, Great Fairies |characters= TotK }}
